integrity: Explicit block sizes, symmetric positive definiteness, ranks, formulas, exact generalized eigenvectors, and exact rational verifier are provided. Finite checks are distinguished from universal analytic proof. Scientific review is performed only by the same model; no independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only real generalized eigenvalues with a nonzero third scaled component in the kernel of the scaled C block; its corrected lower bound is sharp on the displayed low-coupling branch, not claimed optimal in every regime. The counterexample uses deterministic SPD approximation blocks satisfying the source stated structural hypotheses, without asserting that these arise from a particular randomized algorithm. No implications for other spectral branches, complete convergence theorems, or numerical practice are proved. Older equivalent results may exist.
title: A clipped spectral floor for a nullspace branch of double saddle-point preconditioning
